```yaml
name: Check for old group references

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]

jobs:
  check-old-group:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      issues: write
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Search for old group references
        id: grep
        run: |
          if grep -R "kibana/cloud-security-posture" -n .; then
            echo "found=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "found=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Comment on PR if old references found
        if: steps.grep.outputs.found == 'true'
        uses: actions/github-script@v6
        with:
          script: |
            const comment = `⚠️ **Deprecated group reference found**\n\nThe old group name \`kibana/cloud-security-posture\` was found in this PR. Please update all references to \`kibana/contextual-security\` in CODEOWNERS, workflows, and other configuration files.`;
            await github.issues.createComment({
              issue_number: context.issue.number,
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              body: comment
            });

      - name: Fail job if old references found
        if: steps.grep.outputs.found == 'true'
        run: exit 1
```
